name: ai-control-tower
description: Read-only access to the AI Control Tower: risk register, agent registry and AI budget, plus the what-if on cutting AI credits. Uses the bundled sample data, or your Supabase project when configured.

tools.name: get_risks
tools.description: List open AI governance risks, optionally filtered by severity, progress or owner.

tools.name: get_agent_overview
tools.description: Summary of the AI agent registry.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents (e.g. everything in production) with summary and filters.

tools.name: get_unregistered_assets
tools.description: Unregistered AI assets found by the discovery scan.

tools.name: get_budget
tools.description: Monthly AI budget by team group with reconciliation.

tools.name: simulate_credit_cut
tools.description: What-if: what happens if the AI credits are cut by a given percentage? Returns the new overall ceiling and headroom, each team's new utilisation, how many agent runs per day and which processes (agent families) would have to be throttled, which risks rise, and the break-even cut at which the ceiling is reached. Read-only; the model is a transparent rule set over sample data (see assumptions in the result), not a forecast. Use it for questions such as "Was passiert, wenn wir die AI-Credits um 30 % kürzen?".

supabase_url.title: Supabase project URL
supabase_url.description: Optional. Example: https://<project-ref>.supabase.co. Leave empty to use the bundled sample data.

supabase_secret_key.title: Supabase secret key
supabase_secret_key.description: Optional. Server-side secret key (sb_secret_…) of that project. Stored as a secret, never written to config files.
